artifacts.summary: Per-item triage table (quarantine / keep-with-doc-note / wire-in / defer) for the full dead-machinery inventory, with empirical caller-graph re-verification and a load-bearing correction: the review's claim that .claude/rules/ is not auto-loaded is false, so pr-prohibition.md and project-overview-detection.md are not dead.

memory_candidates.content: .claude/rules/*.md files support a YAML frontmatter `paths:` glob that Claude Code's harness auto-loads natively into session context whenever a touched/referenced path matches, completely independent of CLAUDE.md's `@`-import 'Rules References' list. A rule file can be fully live (auto-injected on matching paths) even if absent from CLAUDE.md's @-import list. Confirmed by direct observation: pr-prohibition.md (paths: "**/*") and project-overview-detection.md (paths: .claude/context/repo/project-overview.md) are both natively loaded this way, contradicting a prior review's claim that .claude/rules/ is not auto-loaded. Files with no frontmatter (e.g. no-task-references-in-deliverables.md, source-store-deploy-boundary.md) rely solely on the @-import path instead.

run-all.sh (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/run-all.sh) auto-discovers test suites via two globs per extension: scripts/tests/test-*.sh (narrow) and flat scripts/test-*.sh (broad). Any flat test-*.sh file dropped in an extension's scripts/ root is automatically picked up and run as part of verify-deploy.sh Gate 8, with no further wiring needed. A caller-graph grep for a flat test-*.sh script's basename will show zero explicit callers even though it IS invoked -- the invocation is glob-based, not name-based, so dead-code audits must check run-all.sh's discovery globs before declaring such a script orphaned.

Two confirmed superseded-duplicate script pairs in agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/: roadmap-sync.sh (dead) vs roadmap-integration.sh (live, called by commands/todo.md and skill-todo/SKILL.md); validate-extension-index.sh (dead) vs check-extension-docs.sh's Rule T / check_index_entries_schema (live, wired into verify-deploy.sh Gate 3). Basename-only caller-graph greps miss this class of dead code entirely, since the check they claim to perform is done by a differently-named script -- a dead-code audit should also check for near-synonym script names covering the same docstring-described purpose.
